title: Huffman Coding
description: Write a Zig program that builds a Huffman tree and generates codes for a set of characters with given frequencies.
verificationTest: output.includes('Root freq: 100') && output.includes('Left freq: 55') && output.includes('Right freq: 45')
hints: Huffman coding assigns shorter codes to more frequent characters
Build the tree by repeatedly combining the two lowest-frequency nodes
Left/right branches correspond to 0/1 bits in the code
The root's frequency equals the sum of all character frequencies
